title: 验证卷 #1 · 将来完成时 / 情态被动 / 现在完成时
goal: 诊断卷#1 的错点变式验证：将来完成时结构、不规则动词分词、情态动词被动、现在完成时标志词。全对才算过关。

questions.prompt: By the time the conference ends in June, the organisers ___ over 200 workshops.
questions.explanation: by the time + 将来时间点（会议在 6 月结束）→ 到那个时间点之前已经完成 → 将来完成时 will have + 过去分词。B 只表示将来动作，不强调『届时已完成』；C/D 时态基准点错误。

questions.prompt: By next March, she ____ (work) at the company for exactly ten years.
questions.explanation: by + 将来时间点 + for 时间段 → will have worked。结构：will have + 过去分词；work 是规则动词。

questions.prompt: These outdated regulations ____ (must / reform) before the new term begins.
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动 = 情态动词 + be + 过去分词：must be reformed。口诀：情态动词后接动词原形，被动原形就是 be done。

questions.prompt: Since the new metro line opened, cycling in the city ____ (rise) sharply.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点 → 现在完成时 has + 过去分词；rise 是不规则动词 rise-rose-risen，注意不是 rised。

questions.prompt: 阅读短文，用括号内单词的正确形式填空（注意时态、非谓语与主谓一致）。
questions.passage: Over the past five years, air quality in the city __1__ (improve) significantly. The government encourages residents __2__ (use) public transport, and one of the most effective measures __3__ (be) the congestion charge.
questions.explanation: ① Over the past five years 是现在完成时标志 → has improved；② encourage sb to do sth → to use；③ one of the + 复数名词 + 单数谓语 → is（主语核心是 one）。
